datasets.title: Kenya Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Kenya Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kenya_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2021 and spatially mapped to geographic units in Kenya. The classifications represent current food insecurity situations and scenarios, aggregated into standardized IPC phases to characterize population-level food security impacts.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity conditions across Kenya.
